prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept animation sprite production. Use the provided image ONLY as character identity and EARLY QING CHINESE INK-WASH style reference, not as a scene to preserve. Create a CLEAN HIGH RESOLUTION SQUARE 4-column by 4-row SPRITE ATLAS on genuinely TRANSPARENT background. EXACTLY 16 separate cells, equal square cells, no labels, no grid lines, no ground, no shadows, generous empty gutters. Every figure fully contained in its own cell.
ALL assets same dry/wet black ink, pale gray washes, tapered feather strokes, compact adult BLACK-CROWNED NIGHT HERON with black crown, red iris, gray folded wings, pale belly, yellow avian legs. Not white egret. Anatomically correct TWO bird legs with hocks and long toes, folded wings, one head, no human arms. All night herons face RIGHT, same fixed scale and body position. Their TORSO, hip and tail anchors align identically in every bird cell, torso centered at 42%cell width/53%cell height, feet baseline 88%cell height, head has clear forward space. Never shrink bird because head extends.
ROW1 cells1-4 and ROW2 cells1-4: EIGHT successive key poses of ONE complete continuous RUN CYCLE, neck TUCKED, NO fish. 1 leftfoot lands forward/rightfoot trails;2 leftfoot bearsweight/right swings;3 leftfoot pushesback/right swingsforward;4 brief airborne rightfoot reachesforward;5 rightfoot landsforward/left trails;6 rightfoot bearsweight/left swings;7 rightfoot pushesback/left swingsforward;8 brief airborne leftfoot reachesforward. Noticeable but controlled bird running, low compact body, slight lean, no flight, no extreme cartoon stretching. Keep torso/head identity consistent.
ROW3 cells1-4: same heron torso position and scale, feeding upper-body KEY POSES while rightward running: 1 neck tucked, head level; 2 curved neck reaches down FORWARD to ground at lower-right, beak closed at fish contact location; 3 head lifts midway, beak angled forward; 4 flexible S neck raises head with beak tipped 65degrees UP for swallowing. All four NO FISH, preserve complete full body with two running legs below, do not draw disembodied heads. The rigid torso remains aligned in all cells. Natural modest night-heron neck, not stretched egret neck.
ROW4: cell1 ONE adult GREAT CORMORANT standing facingLEFT calmly, full long bill, dark feathers, pale cheek, feet visible; cell2 EXACT SAME cormorant same scale/bodyanchor but head turned DOWN to empty spot by feet, mild surprise, not attacking; cell3 ONE isolated small realistic freshwater fish pointing RIGHT, 10cm fish for use as separate prop, and nothing else; cell4 ONE isolated tall narrow cluster of riverside REEDS painted with same Chinese ink, no ground.
Everything one coherent ink medium; no photography, no oil rendering, no text or numerals, no decorative paper, no background pixels. Preserve all partial transparency and ink edges. Precise orderly production sheet, not a collage of scenes.
